title: Dahabak tan rugah qidim
intro: Qur'aanak galab kak xaggiime muuci kaxxa nabiyyih raqti uddur mango maritte sittal kataase. Dahabak bicsen duyye inkih tan agattiinah kalbi qimmisseh — takkay immay ta numtin amoh xaagi dubuh kee qusba abaaro gaba kalta. Tah qidim miyya yakkem duudaah?
clues: Anu qibaadah miracsenta hirguh fayya heeh yan kaxxa nabiyyi anewaa wak yooboke.
Anu inni gabat bicse tukteenay mango mara hoxat akah gexannah abe.
Anu bicse dahabak tan gino mano lem celtaah, tet kataytah tan maritte assakat le xongoloola bicissa.
Anu gersi mari edde yaabam duude weem ubleh exceh an — able waytaamih addat culma.
Anu tukteena hargeh qibaadah farmoyti gexo kee qideh laqlaqinte birta.
Anu dubuk meekitaamih nacsiteh suge, baxsale abaaro luk too numuy yi arab xagam maduuda hinnay anu ken arab xagam maduuda.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: diiriyo, xagaanam waaso le gersi mara xagaanama
Qafuuta kee fayyale guddaaqa fan ugte
outcome.answer: diiriyo, xagaanam waaso le gersi mara xagaanama

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
